content: Bu Karribidbun Kore Kururrk Nuye Nawu Kawohrnan Rowk.
Yikahwi bininj ngandimarneyimeng, “Mah! Wardi karrire kore Yawey nuye kunrurrk!” Wanjh ngaye nganjilngmakminj!
Bolkkime ngad ngarridanginj kondah kore kukadje Jerusalem. Ngarringimeng kore kawarnamyo dangmarrhmiyindi ngarre.
Jerusalem wanjh manbolkmakkaykenh kunredkimuk Dja nawu birriyidko bininj minj kabirrimngimen kore kawarnamyo mankimuk ngarre.

Bininj nawu namudbubuyika nuye Yawey wanjh kabirrimbidbun kabirrimornnamerren kondah kore Jerusalem ba bu kabirridjalmanjbun nawu Yawey, bu kunmekbekenh nungka benyingkihwokrayekwong bedberre nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng.
Bu kunkare wanjh kings nawu bindiwohrnawohrnani Israel birriyerrkani kondah kore King David nuye kunrurrk ba bu bindidjadmi bininj bedberre.

Ngad wanjh karrbenmarnedi bininj nawu kabirrihni kore Jerusalem, bu karridjawan God kabenwon kunmodmikenh, wanjh karriyime, “Ngadjare God ngunwon kunmodmikenh nuye ngudda bininj nawu ngurridjare ngurringime kore Jerusalem.
Mak ngadjare God ngunwon kunmodmikenh ngudda bininj nawu ngurrihni kore Jerusalem, dja mak ngunngehke ngudda bininj nawu ngurrihni kururrkkimuk kumekbe.”
Ngabenburrbun nawu namud ngardduk dja mak nawu djawirna ngardduk, wanjh ngayawoyhdi yiwarrudj, dja ngayime, “Ngadjare God ngunwon kunmodmikenh nuye, ngudda nawu ngurrihdi kore Jerusalem!”

Dja mak ngaburrbun kukadje nuye God kadberre nawu Yawey, wanjh ngadjaldi yiwarrudj, dja ngadjawan God bu kabolknahnan Jerusalem, dja mak ngadjare kabenmarnekurduyime kunmak bedberre nawu kabirrihni kumekbe.
